gate.value: python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; import re; s=Path("runbook.md").read_text(); checks={"prerequisites":r"(?im)^##?\s*Prerequisites\b","owner":r"(?im)^Owner:\s*\[[^\]]+\]","backup":r"(?im)^Backup:\s*\[[^\]]+\]","production verification":r"(?i)production.{0,120}(verify|verification)|(?:verify|verification).{0,120}production","failure handling":r"(?i)(if|when).{0,80}(fail|unhealthy|error)","rollback triggers":r"(?im)^##?\s*Rollback triggers\b","rollback actions":r"(?im)^##?\s*Rollback actions\b"}; missing=[k for k,p in checks.items() if not re.search(p,s,re.S if k=="production verification" else 0)]; steps=len(re.findall(r"(?m)^\d+\.\s+",s)); print({"missing":missing,"ordered_steps":steps}); raise SystemExit(0 if not missing and steps>=4 else 1)'
